POL 1: This course will provide an introduction to and basic understanding of Polish language.
POL 2: The course will build on the basic knowledge of reading, grammar and vocabulary acquired in the introductory course to impart fluency and command over written and oral expression; and to introduce further points of basic grammar and idiomatic usage.
POL 3: The course lays equal emphasis on reading, writing, listening and speaking.
